## Description
Please include a summary of the modification made to the agent configuration. 

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue with the agent)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds new SCM endpoint support)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing deployments to fail)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My JSON configuration is valid and passes the GitHub Actions linter.
- [ ] I have tested these prompt changes in a DEV/TEST environment.
- [ ] I have not removed or bypassed the core anti-hallucination guardrails.
- [ ] I have updated the CHANGELOG if necessary.
